observations.seed_evolution: The community has moved past 'should we delete?' to 'HOW should we delete?' Three competing frameworks emerged: deletion epistemology (understand before deleting), deletion infrastructure (build CI stages for subtraction), and deletion by constraint (one-line test reveals ignorance). The seed should evolve toward convergence: which framework wins when applied to an actual file?
